items.title: Mutants & Masterminds equipment — data, runtime, and coverage target
items.detail: Coverage closed AND the provenance defect behind it fixed. The 45/113 measurement was not a content gap, it was a citation defect: all 150 shipped entries were HAND-WRITTEN and every one claimed source "Hero's Handbook", but only 45 of those names exist in the Hero SRD — and even those printed costs the SRD does not (Club 2 vs 1, Bow 6 vs 3, Rocket Launcher 27 vs 19). Plate Armor and Chain Mail each shipped twice under different ids. scripts/encode-mam-equipment.mjs now generates all 113/113 SRD entries (byte-reproducible, cited "M&M 3e Hero SRD") and the six hand-written modules are deleted. Nothing was removed from the product: 25 entries were the SRD's own item renamed (reconciled, SRD stats win) and the 79 genuinely original ones are kept in equipment/original-not-srd.ts under a new, honest source label admitted through a new originalContentSources policy channel rather than the open-content whitelist. Offline gate check:mam-equipment is wired into verify. Networked srd:coverage re-run: 113/113 (100%). SUPERSEDED IN PART 2026-07-30 (GAPS §17.3): the owner decided the question this repair reserved, and the 79 originals were DELETED along with equipment/original-not-srd.ts and the originalContentSources channel itself. M&M equipment now ships 113 entries, all generated and all cited M&M 3e Hero SRD; the devices category disappears with them (all 11 were self-authored and the Hero SRD prints no device row). The compliance surfaces built to keep the 79 out of the ratio are removed as unnecessary: roadmap-metrics drops the Original (non-SRD) column and Open-Content Pop. denominator (M&M reads 390 | 390 | 100%), ManifestEntryStatus drops "original", and src/legal/attributions.ts no longer discloses a split because there is none. check:mam-equipment got STRICTER: every shipped entry must come from an encoder-generated module and cite a Hero SRD source, so the tier cannot grow back. RESIDUAL: the gate compares name/cost/type only — prose fidelity is unaudited; the generated tier carries no structured stat fields (protection/damage/toughness live in the SRD details prose, and deriving them would not be transcription); and the other hand-written M&M data sets (21 non-SRD powers, 1 non-SRD advantage per srd:coverage) have the same defect, untreated.
items.evidence: scripts/encode-mam-equipment.mjs; scripts/check-mam-equipment-provenance.mjs (in npm run verify); scripts/data/mam3e-equipment-manifest.json; docs/mam3e-equipment-provenance.md (item-by-item classification); docs/GAPS.md §17; docs/generated/srd-coverage.md (M&M equipment 113/113)

items.title: 3.5e / PF1e monster denominator shape-mismatch
items.detail: The shape-mismatch is fixed in code: the denominator previously counted SRD 3.5 category headings / PF1e dragon-elemental parent records as if they were individual stat blocks. Pure, unit-tested helpers (src/scripts/srdCoverageShape.ts collapse35eMonsterHeadings + collapsePf1eContainerRecords) now drop those containers and fold 3.5e age/size variants to their archetype, so both denominators count individual stat blocks (the 14 PF1e parents collapse; Skeletal Champion stays a genuine miss). items.title: Provenance over-inclusion audit
items.detail: AUDITED, GATED and ADVERSARIALLY RE-VERIFIED; the remaining remedies are owner decisions. All 1,045 suspects across the 41 wired (system x category) denominators are classified item-by-item with evidence in scripts/data/srd-overinclusion-classification.json under a closed 10-class vocabulary (docs/GAPS.md §18). 753 are NOT provenance problems — the entry is in the cited source and the MEASUREMENT is wrong (591 of those are PF1e equipment/magic-items double-counting each other; the rest are incomplete source slices and granularity mismatches). 117 are catalog hygiene: 69 duplicate-alias rows plus 48 pre-built instances of generic source rows, deliberately NOT remedied by extending normalization, which would clear the report while leaving users two identical crossbows. 173 records (158 distinct entries) are genuine provenance findings — 95 with no counterpart in any cited open-content source and 78 of open content cited to the wrong edition — but only 31 carry a FALSE CITATION today, because 64 of the 95 are M&M originals that §17 already relabelled honestly to Original Content (not SRD); they stay in the licensing class because the trade-dress question on names like Power Ring and Web Shooters is the owner's call. The M&M hand-off this audit predicted in its own text completed 2026-07-26: all 103 deferred records failed the gate exactly as forecast (79 SOURCE-TAG DRIFT + 24 STALE) and were re-recorded or removed. Adversarial re-verification proved all five gate failure modes fire against a control run, and corrected seven records from genuine-non-open-content to wrong-edition-attribution after finding their counterparts in this audit's OWN pinned manifest (Ring of Clumsiness, Cloak of Etherealness, Horn, Sledgehammer, Pixie) — a systematic defect where entries were checked only against their own system's sources. That correction REDUCES claimed exposure. The verifying agents were themselves wrong 25% of the time (5 of 20 claimed M&M counterparts were fabricated), so every applied refutation was re-verified locally against the pinned manifest; refutations resting on external sources were not applied and are recorded in §18.7. Following the §11 OC-1 precedent NOTHING was deleted or relabelled — filterOpenContentBySource drops any entry leaving the allowlist, so re-tagging silently removes shipped content. npm run check:provenance-over-inclusion is now in verify. RESOLVED 2026-07-30 (GAPS §17.3): the licensing class is EMPTY. The owner decided the question the audit reserved — content this project wrote rather than transcribed does not ship — so all 106 entries admitted through the originalContentSources channel were deleted (79 M&M equipment, 27 across the five d20 catalogs), together with Cloak of the Archmagi and Pegasus Boots, which were the same invented content still claiming SRD 5.2 in the 2024 catalog. The policy channel is deleted too, so isOpenContentCompliant admits allowedSources and nothing else and a re-added self-written entry fails the gate rather than finding a door. genuine-non-open-content 89 -> 0; the ledger total 1034 -> 925; wrong-edition-attribution 73 -> 68. RESOLVED 2026-08-01 (GAPS §26): the LAST licensing class is empty too. The owner ruled REPLACE rather than re-tag-and-drop, and executing it showed the ruling's premise held for only part of the population — PF2e has no Basket, Bell, Bucket, Ring Mail or Siangham under any name in any book, verified against both the 1,027-name Pf2eTools index and per-slug probes of Foundry's pf2e pack. 15 records were replaced with the genuine same-edition entry (Handaxe -> Hatchet CRB p.280, Pike -> Longspear, Orc Double Axe -> Orc Necksplitter, Forcecage -> Force Cage APG p.219, Geyser re-transcribed from Secrets of Magic), 13 duplicated an edition-correct row the catalog already shipped (the six flagged 2024 monsters all had their SRD 5.2 qualified forms — Priest Acolyte, Goblin Warrior, Warrior Veteran — already generated and shipping), and 40 had no equivalent and were removed. These were never a labelling problem: Banded Mail shipped in the PF2e catalog as armorClass 4 / dexBonusMax 1, numbers matching no row in a system whose heavy armour is Splint, Half Plate and Full Plate. The seven now-dead foreign-edition strings were removed from the pf2e and pf1e allowlists, so the scope rule and the licence rule are finally separate in that file. wrong-edition-attribution 68 -> 0; licensing-class total: none. REMAINING: the three measurement defects, diagnosed but not repaired (fixing a denominator moves published coverage). Structural limit, stated: a NAME diff cannot see content divergence under a legitimate name — GAPS §15(c) backgrounds are the proof — so the residual is a lower bound, not a measure.
items.evidence: docs/GAPS.md §18; scripts/check-provenance-over-inclusion.mjs; scripts/data/srd-overinclusion-classification.json; scripts/data/srd-overinclusion-manifest.json; src/scripts/srd-coverage.ts (TARGETS exported so the gate pins the same cited sources); docs/generated/srd-coverage.md (over-inclusion table)

items.title: Single-entry content gaps

Verified against the loaders: 5e-2014 'Net'; 5e-2024 "Will-o'-Wisp" at STR 1 (the value re-transcribed for the §13 upstream source-table defect, so the 'verify, do not guess' instruction was already honoured); PF1e 'Greater Teleport'; 3.5e 'Greater Shadow Evocation'. items.title: AI gateway provider-agnosticism (D-AI)
items.detail: DONE — verified against code 2026-08-02, and this entry was stale rather than the work being missing. All three deliverables ship: (1) the provider is ENV-SELECTED via netlify/functions/providerRegistry.mts, which resolves the adapter from AI_PROVIDER and preserves the previous default exactly (unset/blank -> gemini, DEFAULT_AI_PROVIDER); (2) the adapter interface is DOCUMENTED as AiProviderAdapter in src/ai/gatewayCore.ts, including the optional reportUsage third argument and the compatibility rule that adapters predating it keep working; (3) the MOCK adapter is src/ai/mockAdapter.ts, deterministic per task. Scope was exceeded rather than met: three real adapters exist (gemini, anthropic, and the shared aiSdkAdapter), and anthropicAdapter.mts states its own capability gap honestly — Anthropic has no image-generation endpoint, so illustrate-scene fails there with a normalized provider error instead of a faked image. AI surfaces remain default-off behind VITE_AI_ENABLED. Original scope: refactor ai-gateway.mts + adapters so the provider is env-selected; document the adapter interface; add a mock adapter.

items.title: Rate-limiting, analytics, a11y, observability, secrets-audit, backup/DR

Observability closed 2026-07-25: the sync and AI-gateway failure paths now report through errorLogger, so sentry-alerts.md rules (b)/(c) are live rather than dormant. Backup/DR closed for the browser-local store (the data of record): a recovery runbook plus an all-seven-systems lossless export/import round-trip gate. Remaining and RECORDED as decisions in GAPS.md §14 — no analytics network sink (deliberate, not a stub), Sentry release/environment wiring deferred behind the eager-bundle budget, server-side 5xx alerting is ops provisioning, and §12 a11y contrast.

items.title: Release engineering & launch
items.detail: UNBLOCKED 2026-08-02: the open-content licensing hold is fully lifted (docs/GAPS.md §27, WORK_PLAN §8). All three populations that held it are closed — self-authored content deleted (genuine-non-open-content 0, §17.3), the 68 wrong-edition records replaced or removed (§26, licensing-class total: none), and the four 5e-2024 backgrounds re-encoded from the real SRD 5.2 source rather than re-tagged away (§27.2). That last one was the finding a NAME diff structurally cannot see: legitimate SRD 5.2 names over 2014-model text, scored 100% covered with zero over-inclusion. It was closed BY HAND, not by a gate, so the structural limit stands — field-level comparison covers 5e monsters and backgrounds and nothing else, and prose fidelity is unaudited in all seven systems. Remaining scope is unchanged and is engineering, not licensing: final full-gauntlet + whole-corpus adversarial sweep; single deploy target (Netlify; remove stale vercel.json); provision real secrets; staged rollout via feature flags; prod-build Playwright smoke (Chromium+Firefox); rollback rehearsal.
